description: <h1><strong>About HelloFresh</strong></h1> <p>HelloFresh Group reaches more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of 8 consumer brands — from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to pet food and specialty products. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America: the apps, the personalization, the discovery moments, and everything in between that turns food into something people genuinely look forward to.</p> <p>Design is core to how we compete. Our Consumer UX team designs end-to-end experiences across all 8 brands, and we hold a high quality bar — internally, our “zest-appeal” framework defines design excellence from baseline usability through to best-in-class, surprise-and-delight craft. We are also moving fast to an AI-native way of working, where AI rethinks discovery, prototyping, and the path from design to code. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.</p> <h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p>This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.</p> <p>This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.</p> <p>The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.</p> <h1><strong>What You’ll Do: The Recipe</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Lead from the front. </strong>Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Stay hands-on in the work: review designs, jump into critiques, and drive clarity.</li> <li><strong>Turn ambiguity into clarity. </strong>Solve problems from first principles, not templates. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.</li> <li><strong>Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. </strong>From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.</li> <li><strong>Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. </strong>Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Drive design excellence through every detail.</li> <li><strong>Build design-technology capability. </strong>Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.</li> <li><strong>Make us AI-native. </strong>Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.</li> <li><strong>Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. </strong>Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right experience, and raise the ambition of the partners around you.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Team leadership. </strong>A track record of leading and growing high-performing design teams in product-first, consumer (B2C) companies — hiring, coaching, and developing designers at all levels, from IC to managers.</li> <li><strong>High agency. </strong>You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, and lean in to make things happen without waiting for permission.</li> <li><strong>A bias to ship. </strong>Demonstrated success driving teams to ship great software at scale, not just making decks about it — owning execution across a product line and a portfolio of features.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional craft and product taste. </strong>Strong visual and interaction sensibility and a high personal bar for detail. You know what great looks like for a consumer audience, and you can help teams get there — across hierarchy, motion, and micro-interaction.</li> <li><strong>Design-technologist mindset. </strong>Fluency at the design–engineering boundary: design systems, component architecture, prototyping in code or advanced tools, and a practical grasp of front-end constraints.</li> <li><strong>AI-native practice. </strong>You already use AI across the design workflow — for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code — and have a point of view on scaling it responsibly with a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma, Claude, and similar is expected.</li> <li><strong>Scale and systems thinking. </strong>Experience designing and maintaining quality across a multi-brand or multi-market consumer ecosystem, balancing consistency with brand-specific character.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h1> <ol> <li>Your team consistently delivers high-quality consumer product work at speed.</li> <li>You have hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and execution maturity.</li> <li>Experience quality in your domain is visibly higher — the last 10% is sweated, and it shows in what customers feel.</li> <li>Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.</li> <li>Design systems and AI-native workflows in your domain make the whole team faster without sacrificing craft.</li> <li>You are a key player in shaping how HelloFresh builds consumer product in the AI era — writing new playbooks, not following old ones.</li> </ol> <h1><strong>What We Offer: The Toppings</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Scale and impact. </strong>Shape experiences for 6+ million customers across 8 brands and 16 markets.</li> <li><strong>A craft-and-AI-first culture. </strong>Leadership that champions experience quality, innovation, and AI-native ways of working from the top of the organization.</li> <li><strong>Real ownership. </strong>End-to-end accountability for your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.</li> <li><strong>Growth. </strong>A defined leadership track and the chance to expand scope as the alliance scales.</li> <li><strong>Global collaboration. </strong>Work with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech’s international teams.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Coursera + Udemy</strong></p> <p>Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.</p> <p><strong>Why join us now?</strong></p> <p>AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.</p> <p><strong>Shape what comes next</strong></p> <p>By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.</p></div><p><strong>Where we Work</strong></p> <p>Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>This is a senior in-house legal role for a commercially driven lawyer ready to take commercial legal programs work with partners and negotiate technology deals. The role reports directly to the Head of Commercial Legal, Strategic Growth.<br>&nbsp;<br>We operate a hybrid go-to-market model that combines demand-led direct sales, solution-led growth, and indirect distribution through a tiered partner and channel ecosystem. We reach organizations globally through technology alliances, GSI relationships, channel partners, and reseller arrangements — powering learning and capability-building at scale. Legal sits at the center of all three motions.<br>&nbsp;<br>You will be a dedicated legal partner for B2B Enterprise, Technology Alliances, and Channel and Distribution Partnerships, supporting the development and negotiation of the indirect partner ecosystem that underpins our scalable distribution. This is a role for someone who combines deep transactional expertise with strong business instincts, operates with a high degree of independence, and is ready to grow into broader leadership responsibility within a scaling legal function.</p> <p><strong>About your skills</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Exceptional business judgement and a proven ability to balance legal risk with commercial objectives in fast-moving deal environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Executive-level communication skills: able to distill complex issues into clear, actionable guidance and influence stakeholders from SMB to large enterprise and C-suite.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of using approved AI tools to increase legal productivity, and staying current on AI governance obligations.</p> </li> </ul> negotiating complex commercial agreements across global system integrator arrangements, channel partner and reseller agreements, technology alliance and co-sell agreements, enterprise SaaS and platform licensing, API and technical integration agreements, and distribution and go-to-market partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise senior business stakeholders, including GTM leadership, and Product teams, on deal structuring, risk allocation, commercial terms, and multi-jurisdictional GTM considerations, serving as the day-to-day legal lead who positions Legal as a genuine business enabler.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with the Product Legal team to develop and refine legal frameworks that support a self-serve and low-touch commercial motion, including API access agreements, developer terms, usage-based licensing structures, and SMB onboarding frameworks, contributing to a standardized, scalable approach that enables businesses to engage and onboard with speed and minimal friction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide clear, solution-focused guidance on AI-related commercial arrangements, data-sharing agreements, and emerging technology implementations as they enter the enterprise deal mix.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own and continuously develop the suite of enterprise and channel contracting templates, playbooks, negotiation guidelines, and approval frameworks used across the partnerships function.</p> </li> <li> <p>Design scalable legal infrastructure that empowers fast-moving deal teams to execute efficiently while maintaining sound risk controls across both direct and indirect channels.</p> </li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>GTM Product Commercialisation and Third-Party Integration</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as a primary legal partner for the commercialisation of GTM products, advising on go-to-market structures, route-to-market models, pricing and packaging frameworks, and the legal terms that govern how products are brought to market directly and through third parties.</p> </li> <li> <p>Draft and negotiate agreements that govern the embedding, bundling, or distribution of our products within third-party platforms, marketplaces, and ecosystems, including white-label arrangements, OEM agreements, co-branded offerings, and platform integration terms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise on licensing boundaries and revenue-sharing constructs as the product suite evolves and is commercialised through an expanding range of direct and indirect channels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work closely with Product, Product Legal, Marketing, and Sales to ensure commercial and legal structures keep pace with product development and new route-to-market initiatives, flagging and resolving legal considerations early in the product lifecycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll have&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Genuinely commercial in your approach: able to identify and manage risk pragmatically, find workable solutions under pressure, and avoid being a blocker to growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>An effective communicator and influencer, comfortable advising and challenging senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Executive leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p>Qualified lawyer with 10+ years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house tenure at a technology, SaaS, or enterprise software company.</p> </li> <li> <p>A proven track record negotiating complex B2B technology agreements including GSI, channel, reseller, alliance, and enterprise platform deals, ideally within or alongside global organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable experience advising on product commercialisation, route-to-market strategy, or third-party distribution and embedding arrangements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable operating across both high-touch enterprise deals and high-volume standardised indirect channel frameworks, understanding that each requires a different legal posture.</p> </li> <li> <p>Highly organised and self-directed, with a demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume deal workload across competing priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.</p> </li> <li> <p>A collaborative team player who understands their place in a broader legal function and actively supports those around them, including upward to leadership</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Posting Date: </strong>15 September 2026<br><strong>Application Window: 2 weeks</strong><br>We anticipate the application window will be open until 30 September 2026. Based on business needs, this opportunity may remain posted beyond or closed before the anticipated application window.</p> <p class="p1"><strong><em>#LI-ST5</em></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Why work here?</strong></h3> <p><strong>You’ll grow here.</strong><strong><br></strong>Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.</p> <p><strong>AI is real here.</strong><strong><br></strong>We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.</p> <p><strong>You’ll own your work.</strong><strong><br></strong>We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.</p> <p><strong>You’ll see your impact.</strong><strong><br></strong>What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?</p> <p><em>Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s <strong>LEARN</strong>&nbsp;together.&nbsp;</em></p> <h3><strong>Our Benefits Start with U</strong></h3> <p>Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. or sales performance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>Reporting into the Commercial CFO, the role is split into the below key areas:</p> <p><strong>Financial Control &amp; Reporting</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Full ownership of divisional month‑end close processes across all Nutrition brands, including Myprotein.</li> <li>Build and lead the Nutrition consolidation and <p><strong>Strategic Leadership &amp; Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support major strategic programmes including international expansion, organisational transformation, and business separation.</li> <li>Partner across all areas of the business—including supply chain, trading, and marketing—to ensure investments drive sustainable, profitable growth.</li> <li>Work collaboratively with group finance functions such as Tax, Treasury, and Group Reporting to ensure seamless alignment and compliance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Operations Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, motivate, and develop a multi‑disciplinary finance team of up to 25 colleagues.</li> <li>Oversee day‑to‑day finance operations, ensuring an efficient, well‑controlled, and high‑performing finance function.</li> <li>Drive a proactive, solutions‑led approach to identifying risks and opportunities across the short, medium, and long term.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Within these areas the role will require:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An inspirational leader, who thrives on being able to drive and work with an ambitious team to achieve goals aligned to the business’ need.</li> <li>A business.</li> <li>A strong attention to detail to ensure a tightly controlled balance sheet is delivered consistently, reviewing the wider team’s work.</li> <li>A keen ability to multi-task across a number of areas and manage both their own and the teams time effectively.</li> <li>An ability to communicate with wider finance functions outside of the division, including Group, Tax, Treasury etc, to ensure all relevant information is provided and received for reporting purposes.</li> <li>A collaborative approach to working with the wider divisional finance team including commercial, to assist with reporting and profit delivery, and SSC, to ensure a tightly controlled working capital cycle</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <div> <ul> Balance Sheet, with strong expertise in financial control, reporting, consolidation, and compliance.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record in commercial finance, including profit improvement, cost management, working capital optimisation, budgeting and forecasting.</li> <li>A credible and influential strategic partner, confident in challenging and guiding non‑financial stakeholders at all description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.&nbsp;<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Strategic Account Executive.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to&nbsp;sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on Southern Europe. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and GP growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.</li> <li>Growing our revenue and gross profit share of wallet within your key account list.&nbsp;</li> <li>Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.</li> <li>Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.</li> <li>Selling solutions to a technical and business audience.&nbsp;</li> <li>Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.</li> <li>Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.</li> <li>Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>*Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base.&nbsp;</li> <li>History of working with accounts ranging from large multinational enterprise customers to SMB.&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrated success by achieving quota on a consistent basis.</li> <li>Track record of Account Management experience and a solid understanding of how to cross sell and upsell solutions within a mature customer base.&nbsp;</li> <li>A solid understanding of financial reporting within a direct customer base - Revenue and Gross Profit tracking, Risk and Opportunity (net new business) cadence.</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French</strong>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience.</li> <li>Experience and understanding of working in the communications market is preferable. Have sold or worked with Messaging, Voice Calling, Email, Account Security Verification. Or have prior experience in a traditional telecommunications environment/business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain</p> <p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25%&nbsp; travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. title: Chief of Staff - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>This is a high-impact opportunity to work directly alongside one of Banyan’s seasoned Operating Leaders, each overseeing a portfolio of software businesses in a buy, hold and grow investment model. As <strong>Chief of Staff</strong>, you become a trusted right hand to your Operating Leader and a close working partner to the CEOs and functional leaders across their companies.</p> <p>The role is deliberately broad. Rather than a fixed rotation, you will move across multiple operating companies and business problems: shaping a go-to-market plan for one company, improving customer onboarding at another, or standing up the first 100 days of a newly acquired business. You will gain exposure to software M&amp;A, but the core of the job is hands-on value creation and operating work. You own initiatives end to end.</p> <p>The <strong>Executive Leadership Program</strong> (ELP) runs two years. Development is intentional. You will work through a range of experiences spanning go-to-market, M&amp;A, customer, and finance priorities portfolio-wide, plus gain hands-on leadership reps, with regular check-ins and development opportunities to ready you for your next role. High performers move from the ELP program into a CEO or C-suite role within a Banyan operating company, or into a leadership role at Banyan Software HQ.</p> <p>For those who want to learn how great vertical software businesses are built and run, and who want the fastest path available to running one themselves, this is the job.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Gain</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A cohort of high-calibre peers</strong>. You grow and learn alongside other ELPs at Banyan, building a long-term network of future operators.</li> <li><strong>Direct apprenticeship with senior operators</strong>. You will work very closely with an Operating Leader and see first-hand how experienced leaders make decisions across different software businesses.</li> <li><strong>Dedicated development support</strong>. External executive coaching in Year 2, plus mentorship from Operating Leaders with decades of software experience.</li> <li><strong>The fastest track we offer to running a business</strong>. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://klaviyo.com/careers" data-renderer-mark="true">klaviyo.com/careers</a>&nbsp;to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.</em></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Klaviyo is a public company with more than $1.5 billion in annual revenue. Enterprise is our fastest growing segment, where global brands are consolidating their marketing and customer data onto Klaviyo and spending over seven figures a year with us. We have expanded beyond retail into hospitality, media, healthcare, and business services.</p> <p>You will go after some of the largest brands in the world, including Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, prospecting your way in and taking full responsibility for your pipeline target.</p> <p>Most of these companies run separate tools for email, SMS, customer data, and service. We win by bringing it all onto one platform and getting the customer to results faster. Once they are live, you will keep growing the account and lead the renewal.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Prospect your own territory.</strong> Research every account, find a way in, and build relationships where Klaviyo has none today. BDR, marketing, and partner leads add to the pipeline you build.</li> <li><strong>Be the CEO of your territory.</strong> Build a plan for every named account, create and prospect into a relationship map, and pull in solutions engineering, value management, partners, and marketing at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Run business-value discovery.</strong> Find the real problem, put a number on it with the customer, and build a business case for the full platform that their finance team will support.</li> <li><strong>Sell to the full buying committee.</strong> Get to the CMO, CFO, CIO or CDO. Build champions and test them.</li> <li><strong>Win the competitive deals.</strong> Displace the incumbent, hold your price, and have a clear answer on why Klaviyo and why now.</li> <li><strong>Close and forecast with discipline.</strong> Run the mutual action plan, security and legal review, and procurement. Forecast against what the customer has agreed to.</li> <li><strong>Grow and renew.</strong> Expand into more products and teams, spot risk early, and negotiate renewals that make room for growth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years in enterprise software sales, with 7+ years selling to C-level executives from a field sales position</li> <li>A proven hunter who has built pipeline from scratch through your own research and outreach, and closed new logos from it</li> <li>Experience selling into organizations above $1B in revenue</li> <li>A track record of closing annual contracts of $1M or more</li> <li>At or above quota in at least two of the last three years, on a multi-million dollar target</li> <li>Experience leading complex deals from start to finish, coordinating your internal team and the customer's decision makers</li> <li>Experience running several complex deals that can last between nine and eighteen months</li> <li>Multi-product platform selling, with more than one product sold into the same account</li> <li>A deep understanding of MEDDPICC and a value-based selling methodology, including building business cases</li> <li>Domain experience in MarTech, CDPs, customer engagement platforms, ecommerce, or an adjacent data platform</li> <li>Partner-led selling experience, and a record of winning competitive deals against existing platforms</li> <li>Experience growing existing accounts through expansion and renewal</li> <li>Strong executive presence, and fluency in CRM, forecasting, conversation intelligence, and AI tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role requires approximately 30 to 40 percent travel for customer meetings, executive briefings, partner work, and industry events.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.</p> <p>In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE&nbsp; range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range in Local Currency:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£98,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£147,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.</em></p> <p><strong>Get to Know Klaviyo</strong></p> <p>We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.</p> <p><em>AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>By participating in Klaviyo’s interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.klaviyo.com/careers/ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.klaviyo.com/careers/ai-guidance&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1761072778777000&amp;usg=AOvVaw0auUcRqeYRczM9UoXAKldj">Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process</a>. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/job-applicant-privacy-notice" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/job-applicant-privacy-notice&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1761072778777000&amp;usg=AOvVaw1axMoReIM1qwTbmaPcLI_b">Job Applicant Privacy Notice</a>.<br></em></p> <p><em>Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non-discrimination. title: UX Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.</span></p></div><p>Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric air taxi. This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org is building consumer software for people who love to fly: mobile apps, websites, and web apps for flyers, flight enthusiasts, and pilots. We haven't announced what we're building, and we're not going to spoil it in a job posting. What we can tell you: it's a consumer app with a large user base, and the design decisions made in the next year will define the next chapter of growth for the product.</p> <p>That's why we're hiring a UX Product Designer; specifically, someone who has shipped consumer apps that real people download, rate, and decide to keep or delete, and who can take a loosely defined problem and come back with something worth building.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>End-to-end product design for consumer aviation apps on iOS and Android, along with the websites and web apps that support them</li> <li>Design for a wide range of users, from casual flyers and aviation enthusiasts to working pilots who need information that's fast, accurate, and trustworthy</li> <li>Run product explorations: sketch out directions, pressure-test them with users and the team, and kill the weak ones early</li> <li>You'll get context and constraints from Design Leadership, PM and engineering, but the design leadership on your projects is yours</li> <li>Ship to the App Store and Google Play, then keep refining based on how people actually use what you shipped: analytics, experiments, reviews, and user research</li> <li>Raise the bar on craft across the org, through your own work and through feedback on everyone else's</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product design experience minimum.&nbsp;</li> <li>A track record of shipping features for consumer mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, ideally at a startup, a big tech company, or both</li> <li>Products you've designed that are live and in users' hands. We will ask about them, in detail: what you decided, what you got wrong, what you'd change</li> <li>Deep fluency in native iOS and Android design (Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design) and strong systems thinking across mobile and web. You know when a pattern should be shared across platforms and when it shouldn't</li> <li>Experience using data to shape design decisions, from engagement and retention metrics to App Store feedback</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity. If you need a fully scoped ticket before you can start, this won't be a fit</li> <li>A portfolio that shows your thinking, not just polished final screens</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You're a pilot, student pilot, plane spotter, or all-around aviation nerd. You'd be designing for people like you, and that matters</li> <li>Experience designing consumer apps built around real-time data, maps, or location</li> <li>Experience growing a consumer app: onboarding, retention, subscriptions, or monetization, social posting and marketing collateral</li> <li>Experience working alongside AI/ML teams, or designing products with AI-driven features</li> <li>You've shipped consumer products in a domain with real-world constraints (regulated industries, safety-adjacent, hardware-adjacent) and know how that shapes design</li> </ul> <p><strong>About The Team:</strong></p> <p>AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. You get the resources and momentum of a real org, but the product development startup culture of a smaller team based in the UK – building for an audience that genuinely cares about flying.</p> <p>If you want to hear more about what we're building before you apply, you can't. Apply, and we'll tell you plenty.</p> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Archer is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs. Applicants who may require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should provide their name and contact information to Archer’s People Team at&nbsp;<a ----- ----- Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case-by-case basis.</span></h5> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Archer's <a href="https://archer.com/legal/personnel-candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy</a>.</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Certain positions may be eligible for visa sponsorship.</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Archer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. All aspects of employment are decided on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.</span></h5> <h5><span style="font-weight: 400;">Archer Aviation does not engage with external recruiting agencies/individual recruiters with whom it does not have a prior written agreement. Archer reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes that it receives and bears no responsibility for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes. If you are a recruiting agency or individual recruiter wishing to do business with Archer, please reach out to&nbsp;<a ----- ----- All employment processes are managed by the Archer People Team.</span></h5></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Bid Manager, UK&I (Public Sector technology)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Bid Manager, UK &amp; Ireland</strong></p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>As a Lead Bid Manager, you will lead Axon’s most complex and highest-impact RFP and tender responses, proposals, and other customer-facing selling documents across the UK and Ireland. You’ll be a member of a global team that supports Axon sales worldwide and will serve as the senior proposal execution lead for the region. You will own proposal development from early procurement engagement through submission and evaluation-period follow-up, translating established win strategy into a controlled response plan and ensuring the final submission is compliant, responsive, scorable, customer-focused, and on time. Your strengths in judgment under ambiguity, cross-functional leadership, technical and proposal writing, and compliance discipline will be central to success.</p> <p>Focused primarily on UK and Ireland public-sector opportunities, you will work closely with Sales, Bid Strategy, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, Finance, Services, and executive stakeholders. You will personally lead the hardest pursuits while also strengthening regional proposal readiness, reusable standards, coaching, and execution across bids owned by other Proposal Managers. This is an office-based position in the United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> hybrid schedule of Monday working remotely, and Tue-Fri in our London office<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director, Global Proposals<br><strong>Direct Reports:</strong> N/A</p> <p>At Axon, the Lead Proposal Manager is the senior owner of proposal execution for the region’s most complex pursuits. You will engage early in the procurement process, establish how the response will be run, make execution and compliance decisions within approved boundaries, and carry the proposal through submission and evaluation-period deliverables. This is a comprehensive individual-contributor role requiring expertise in the following areas:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Proposal Planning &amp; Execution:</strong> Translate established win strategy into an executable response architecture, including workstreams, assignments, proof collection, review cadence, decision gates, and submission-readiness criteria. Build pre-bid readiness for anticipated strategic procurements with Sales and Bid Strategy. Drive resolution of product exceptions, compliance issues, and proposal commitments through the appropriate approval paths, while partnering with Sales, Bid Strategy, Pricing, and leadership on commercial, account-strategy, and bid decisions.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong> Lead large cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Security, Pricing, Finance, Services, Proposal Team members, and executive stakeholders. Drive decisions, close gaps, enforce deadlines, adjudicate conflicting review input, and coach Proposal Managers and Specialists to improve execution judgment, compliance discipline, and independent ownership.</li> <li><strong>Project &amp; Compliance Management:</strong> Own proposal governance, milestones, compliance traceability, mandatory requirements, forms, schedules, portals, review cycles, final packaging, and submission readiness. Identify and manage disqualification and responsiveness risks, and preserve proposal context through structured handoff of assumptions, exceptions, commitments, and unresolved risks during clarification, presentation, and other evaluation-period activity.</li> <li><strong>Proposal Writing &amp; Solution Fluency:</strong> Develop technical and solution fluency to challenge weak claims, identify risk, and frame partial or non-compliant requirements carefully. Write, edit, and integrate high-value content when SME inputs are incomplete, inconsistent, overly technical, or insufficiently responsive, producing a coherent response for technical and non-technical evaluators.</li> <li><strong>Regional Leadership &amp; Stakeholder Collaboration:</strong> Build strong operating relationships with UK and Ireland Sales and technical leaders, monitor regional delivery health, identify where pursuits need additional support or escalation, and provide Proposal Leadership with recommendations on complex-pursuit routing and resourcing. Identify repeatable success and failure patterns and improve regional execution through reusable standards, tools, proof sources, training, and workflow changes.</li> </ul> <p>What You Bring</p> <ul> <li>Typically 8+ years of proposal, bid, tender, or comparable pursuit experience, including repeated end-to-end ownership of large, ambiguous, high-stakes submissions with significant cross-functional stakeholder load and formal review cycles.</li> <li>Strong UK public-sector tender experience, including procurement routes, evaluation structures, frameworks and call-offs, mandatory requirements, submission mechanics, and evaluator expectations.</li> <li>Experience with major policing, blue-light/public safety, central government, defence/security, justice, or complex public-sector technology procurements is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading responses with strict compliance, controlled submission, and potential disqualification or non-responsive risk, with sound judgment about execution tradeoffs, prioritization of competing risks and deadlines, and when Product, Legal, Pricing, or strategy approval is required.</li> <li>Excellent proposal writing and editing skills, combined with the technical learning agility to challenge claims, identify solution risk, and turn uneven or highly technical inputs into clear, evaluator-focused, defensible content.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, handle constructive conflict, and escalate with clear options and a recommended path.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to improve proposal execution beyond personally owned bids through standards, tools, processes, training, proof sources, or other reusable practices.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to coach Proposal Managers or other proposal practitioners and improve their independent execution quality.</li> <li>Comfort with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Salesforce or comparable CRM, proposal-management platforms such as QorusDocs, Responsive/RFPIO, or Qvidian, and AI-enabled workflow tools. Formal proposal-development training or exposure to Shipley, APMP, Sant, or equivalent is preferred; strong tool judgment and learning agility matter more than experience with any one platform.</li> </ul> <p>Benefits that Benefit You</p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation and UK retirement benefits</li> <li>Company bonus scheme</li> <li>30 days paid time off</li> <li>Private medical insurance and health cash plan</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Numerous insurance coverages (disability, long-term sick etc.)</li> <li>Health and wellbeing benefits</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development programs</li> <li>Office amenities</li> <li style="font-style: italic;"><em>...and many more.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits and eligibility are governed by Axon's applicable UK plans and policies and may vary based on the nature of your employment and work location.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" ----- target="_blank" ----- ----- via our&nbsp;<a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Axon Privacy Web Form</a>. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.</a></em></p> <p><em>Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.</em></p> <p><em>We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email <a ---------- </a>&nbsp;Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. description: <h2><strong>About Scale AI</strong></h2> <p>Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI initiatives through our data annotation platform, generative AI solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities.</p> <h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>As a Forward Deployed AI Engineering Manager on our Enterprise team, you'll be the technical bridge between Scale AI's cutting-edge AI capabilities and our most strategic customers. You'll work with enterprise clients to understand their unique challenges, lead a team that architects specific AI solutions, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of AI systems in production environments.</p> <p>This is a Management role that combines deep engineering and AI expertise, leading a team, and working on customer-facing problems. You'll work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate AI into their critical workflows.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Customer Integration &amp; Deployment</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their technical infrastructure, data pipelines, and business requirements</li> <li>Design and implement custom integrations between Scale AI's platform and customer data environments (cloud platforms, data warehouses, internal APIs)</li> <li>Build robust data connectors and ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and prepare customer data for AI workflows</li> <li>Deploy and configure AI models and agents within customer security and compliance boundaries</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI Agent Development</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Develop production-grade AI agents tailored to customer use cases across domains like customer support, data analysis, content generation, and workflow automation</li> <li>Architect multi-agent systems that orchestrate between different models, tools, and data sources</li> <li>Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance and iterate toward business objectives</li> <li>Design human-in-the-loop workflows and feedback mechanisms for continuous agent improvement</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Prompt Engineering &amp; Optimization</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create sophisticated prompt engineering strategies optimized for customer-specific domains and data</li> <li>Build and maintain prompt libraries, templates, and best practices for customer use cases</li> <li>Conduct systematic prompt experimentation and A/B testing to improve model outputs</li> <li>Implement RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) systems and fine-tuning pipelines where appropriate</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Leadership &amp; Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the Engineering Manager and technical point of contact for strategic We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Keyfactor&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span data-teams="true">Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!</span></p></div><p><strong>Title</strong>: Senior RFP &amp; Bid Manager, EMEA&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: Stockholm, Sweden; Aachen, Germany; Barcelona or Madrid, Spain; United Kingdom</p> <p><strong>Experience</strong>: Senior</p> <p><strong>Job Function</strong>: Revenue Operations</p> <p><strong>Employment Type</strong>: Full-Time</p> <p><strong>Industry</strong>: Computer and Network Security&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">About the position</span></strong></p> <p>The Senior RFP &amp; Bid Manager, EMEA is responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving the RFP, RFI, and tender response management framework across Keyfactor's EMEA sales organization. Operating as a specialized individual contributor, the role owns the operational processes, governance standards, tools, and knowledge management practices required to support effective and consistent bid responses.</p> <p>The position coordinates the end-to-end RFP response process, working closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and other relevant departments to obtain required inputs, manage timelines and dependencies, and facilitate accurate, complete, and timely submissions. The role applies specialized knowledge of bid management practices and procurement procedures to identify operational risks, recommend appropriate response approaches, and drive improvements in process effectiveness and efficiency.&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of a newly established function, the role develops scalable operating practices and documentation to support the continued development of RFP management capabilities within EMEA and potential future adoption in other regions.</p> <p>This position can be based out of our offices in following locations and we have a hybrid work model: operational processes in a developing functional environment.</li> <li>Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and manage dependencies while maintaining effective working relationships.</li> About the role

Based in the UK you will be a key member of the Manufacturing Operations team where you will drive the development of our business management systems as well as our product, supplier, software and customer quality initiatives.

You will be comfortable with assessing processes and technologies to identify quality gaps and provide robust but pragmatic solutions to drive all aspects of the business in achieving the highest levels of quality and resilience.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and deliver the company quality strategy, policy and objectives, aligned to the product roadmap and growth plan.

  • Build, lead and develop a quality team covering supplier, product, reliability, software and systems quality.

  • Define and report quality performance to the executive team.

  • Establish appropriate document control, change control, CAPA, internal audit, training and records processes that scale with a fast-growing fabless company.

  • Work with PMO to embed quality gates into the new product introduction (NPI) and product lifecycle process, from concept through end of life.

  • Own quality across the supply chain: wafer foundry, assembly and packaging, wafer and final test, PCB/PCBA and system-level contract manufacturers.

  • Lead supplier selection, qualification, audits and ongoing performance management, including scorecards and quarterly business reviews.

  • Work with engineering leaders to define software quality standards across drivers, firmware, compilers, SDKs and runtime.

  • Establish release criteria, test coverage expectations, defect management and regression processes, aligned with CI/CD practice.

  • Bring in secure development and software supply chain practice, including SBOMs and vulnerability management.

  • Support responsible AI and AI management practice where customers ask for it, including awareness of ISO/IEC 42001.

  • Be the senior point of contact for customer quality, audits and escalations.

  • Lead customer RMA and complaint handling, root cause analysis and 8D responses to agreed timelines.

  • Ensure product compliance with RoHS, REACH, WEEE, conflict minerals reporting, UKCA and CE marking, and relevant safety and EMC standards.

Essential experience and skills

  • Significant experience in quality roles in semiconductors or electronics hardware, including creating and leading a quality function or team.

  • Direct experience managing quality through outsourced manufacturing: foundries, OSATs, test houses and/or contract manufacturers.

  • Deep knowledge of ISO 9001 and hands-on experience building or running a certified QMS.

  • Working knowledge of semiconductor qualification and reliability (JEDEC), failure analysis and

  • Awareness of data centre RAS assessments and HPC system qualification and certification.

  • Fluency in core quality tools: 8D, FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA and root cause analysis.

  • Experience handling customer quality escalations with large, demanding customers.

  • Degree in electrical or electronic engineering, materials science, physics or a related discipline.

  • Clear, confident communicator who can influence engineers, suppliers and executives, and hold partners to account.

  • Willing to travel internationally, including to Asia and US, for supplier audits and customer quality reviews.

Desirable

  • Experience in a fabless company, particularly one bringing an initial product to volume.

  • Background in high-performance compute, data centre, networking or AI hardware.

  • Exposure to software quality, release management or secure development practice.

  • Lead auditor certification (ISO 9001), Six Sigma Black Belt, or chartered status (for example CQI or IET).

  • Experience working with suppliers in Taiwan, South Korea or US.

The impact you will have

You will help Fractile to makes sure every one of our suppliers builds to our standard, and that our customers receive AI hardware and software they can trust in production whilst shaping the quality culture across engineering, operations and commercial teams.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation.

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence
description: Job title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence Location: London; full in-office working as default Start date: ASAP Reports to: CEO Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required) Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time ___________________________________________________________________________ Help put frontier AI to work in Defence Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations. We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints. We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government. We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery. You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability. ___________________________________________________________________________ What you'll do Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases. Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence. Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems. Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation. Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints. Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes. Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects. Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures. Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders. Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution. Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities. Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving. Work directly with Defence customers Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem. Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference. Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans. Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart. Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments. Turn research into operational capability Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems. Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability. Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement. Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints. Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams. Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it. ___________________________________________________________________________ What we’re looking for You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work. You should be comfortable: Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch. Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models. Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance. Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints. Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute. Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities. Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users. Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth. Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear. You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems. Nice to have Existing UK security clearance, such as SC or DV, or previous experience working in secure Defence environments. Experience with signal processing, time-series data, sensor fusion, representation learning or machine learning applied to complex real-world datasets. Experience with foundation models, multimodal learning or advanced model training and post-training techniques. Experience deploying ML models to edge devices or constrained compute environments. Familiarity with UK Defence procurement, technical assurance or the national security landscape. Experience leading technical workstreams or working as a technical lead on customer-facing ML projects. ___________________________________________________________________________ What success looks like In your first three months, we would expect you to: Become the technical lead for a major applied Defence ML programme, with responsibility for its day-to-day technical progress. Build strong working relationships with Cosine's ML researchers, engineers and key Defence customer stakeholders. Develop a clear understanding of the existing models, datasets, technical architecture and operational objectives.
