Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: CEO

Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion

Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required)

Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time

___________________________________________________________________________

Help put frontier AI to work in Defence

Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.

We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints.

We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.

We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery.

You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you'll do

  • Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems

  • Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases.

  • Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence.

  • Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems.

  • Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation.

  • Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints.

  • Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes.

Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment

  • Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects.

  • Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures.

  • Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders.

  • Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution.

  • Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities.

  • Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving.

Work directly with Defence customers

  • Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem.

  • Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference.

  • Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans.

  • Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart.

  • Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments.

Turn research into operational capability

  • Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems.

  • Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability.

  • Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement.

  • Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints.

  • Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams.

  • Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for

You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work.

You should be comfortable:

  • Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.

  • Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models.

  • Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance.

  • Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints.

  • Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute.

  • Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities.

  • Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users.

  • Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth.

  • Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear.

  • You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems.

Nice to have

  • Existing UK security clearance, such as SC or DV, or previous experience working in secure Defence environments.

  • Experience with signal processing, time-series data, sensor fusion, representation learning or machine learning applied to complex real-world datasets.

  • Experience with foundation models, multimodal learning or advanced model training and post-training techniques.

  • Experience deploying ML models to edge devices or constrained compute environments.

  • Familiarity with UK Defence procurement, technical assurance or the national security landscape.

  • Experience leading technical workstreams or working as a technical lead on customer-facing ML projects.

___________________________________________________________________________

What success looks like

In your first three months, we would expect you to:

  • Become the technical lead for a major applied Defence ML programme, with responsibility for its day-to-day technical progress.

  • Build strong working relationships with Cosine's ML researchers, engineers and key Defence customer stakeholders.

  • Develop a clear understanding of the existing models, datasets, technical architecture and operational objectives.

  • Establish a focused delivery plan with clear priorities, milestones, ownership and success measures.

  • Make meaningful hands-on contributions to model development, evaluation or deployment.

  • Identify and begin addressing the most important technical and operational blockers.

  • Demonstrate tangible progress to customer stakeholders and build confidence in Cosine's ability to deliver.

  • Longer term, you'll help take advanced ML capabilities from promising prototypes into operational use, while shaping how Cosine builds and delivers applied AI for Defence and other mission-critical organisations.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why this role matters

Some of the most important applications of AI won't be found in consumer products. They'll be in environments where information is incomplete, systems are complex, security matters and the consequences of getting things wrong are significant.

Cosine is working to bring frontier machine learning into those environments.

Doing that requires more than good models. It requires people who can understand an operational problem, build something that works, make good technical decisions, coordinate the work needed to deliver it and stay close to the customer until it creates real value.

You'll have unusual proximity to cutting-edge ML research, senior Defence stakeholders and the operational challenges that will shape the next generation of AI capabilities.

This role will suit someone who is technically strong enough to build, organised enough to lead technical delivery and curious enough to engage directly with the people using the technology.

If you enjoy being close to the research, close to customers and personally accountable for turning ambitious technology into something real, come and work with us.

Come help make frontier AI useful where it matters most.

We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.

___________________________________________________________________________

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

What you can expect:

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market

  • Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create

  • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly

  • Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work

  • High-quality equipment to do your best work

We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.

Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps.

This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

  • Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in Paris, France. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

  • Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

raw.description:
TL;DR: We are looking for a gap-year or final-year student to work alongside the leadership team on Davis's go-to-market, strategy and growth.


About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The role

The role is cross-functional. You work directly with the whole team: the CEO and the Real Estate Partner as much as the tech teams.

Together with them, you take part in decisions on company strategy, client acquisition and relationships, and product improvement. Your analyses form the basis for these decisions.

Client relationships and deliverables

  • Contribute to studies for our developer and investor clients, from data analysis to final formatting.

  • Incorporate client feedback and improve deliverable quality from one version to the next.

  • Gather client needs and feedback, then turn them into concrete proposals to shape the offer and improve the product.


Product improvement

  • Turn recurring work methods into automated tools and processes, with the tech teams.

  • Formalise the methods and quality standards these tools reproduce.

  • Test these tools on real cases and suggest improvements.

  • Support their adoption by the team: documentation, onboarding, user feedback.

Go-to-market and client acquisition

  • Define the priority client segments and the decision-makers to approach.

  • Build the target account list and identify entry points and partnerships.

  • Prepare prospecting materials and key meetings.

Strategy and planning

  • Maintain the business plan and prepare the analyses that inform leadership decisions, including with investors.

Profile

  • Education: student at a top business or engineering school, on a gap year or in your final year.

  • Experience: a first internship in strategy consulting, investment banking, growth/VC, a leading real estate investment fund or a start-up.

  • Key skills: strong synthesis and presentation skills, a real appetite for AI tools and a genuine interest in the real estate sector.

Analytical skills

  • Ability to study a market (size, dynamics, players, prices, demand), structure it, segment targets and build a clear, verifiable model.

  • Ability to structure a client presentation and deliver it.

  • Rigour and attention to detail in analysis.

  • Strong writing skills, in French and English.

Additional skills

  • Strong intellectual curiosity, with an appetite for real estate and for AI tools.

  • Autonomy and the ability to get up to speed quickly on new topics.

  • Ease in dealing with leadership, clients and partners.

  • Enjoys working with tech teams. Knowledge of real estate is a plus.

Why join Davis?

You will work closely with the leadership team, with a full view of strategy, business development, clients and product.

You will have broad autonomy and a direct impact on company decisions.

You will learn to use AI as an everyday productivity lever, on high-stakes topics.

Package

  • 6-month full-time internship

  • Offices in Paris 75002

  • Meal vouchers

  • 50% of public transport costs covered

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

 

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

 

Why we'll win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

Lengow, expert des solutions e-commerce intelligentes  Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes, qui accompagne les marques et les distributeurs dans leur croissance rentable sur les canaux digitaux. Grâce à ses solutions performantes de gestion de flux produits, de veille tarifaire internationale et d'analyse de données, Lengow propose une suite complète d'outils SaaS permettant aux e-commerçants d'améliorer la visibilité de leurs produits en ligne, de renforcer leur compétitivité grâce à des stratégies de prix éclairées, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de suivre la présence de leur marque auprès des distributeurs. Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne la croissance digitale de plus de 3 600 clients, sur des milliers de canaux marketing et de vente, dans plus de 60 pays. Votre rôle au sein de la Legal Team Dans le cadre de nos activités, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Juriste en Droit du Numérique & Protection des Données Personnelles pour rejoindre notre Legal Team. Directement rattaché.e à la Head of Legal, vous participerez activement aux projets juridiques de l'entreprise, avec une attention particulière portée à la conformité RGPD, aux évolutions réglementaires du secteur numérique et aux enjeux liés à l'intelligence artificielle. Vous aurez également l'opportunité de collaborer avec différentes équipes internes (Product, Tech, Sales, Marketing, HR, etc.) et de développer une approche pratique et opérationnelle du droit. Vos missions 1. Protection des données personnelles & conformité RGPD Participer au suivi et à l'amélioration de la conformité de Lengow en matière de protection des données personnelles. Contribuer à la mise à jour du registre des activités de traitement des données personnelles, en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes. Participer à la revue et à la mise à jour de la documentation relative à la protection des données (politiques de confidentialité, DPA, procédures internes, etc.). Accompagner la Legal Team dans l'analyse de questions relatives au RGPD et à la protection des données dans le cadre des projets de l'entreprise. Contribuer à la sensibilisation des équipes internes aux enjeux de protection des données, notamment à travers la préparation et l'animation de courtes formations sur les notions fondamentales du RGPD et les bonnes pratiques à adopter au quotidien. 2. Droit du numérique & Intelligence Artificielle Participer à l'analyse des enjeux juridiques liés aux nouvelles technologies, aux solutions SaaS et à l'intelligence artificielle. Contribuer au suivi des évolutions réglementaires européennes, notamment du Règlement européen sur l'intelligence artificielle (AI Act), et à l'évaluation de leurs impacts potentiels sur les activités de Lengow. Participer aux réflexions et projets internes relatifs à l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle et à la mise en place de bonnes pratiques. 3. Contrats commerciaux & accompagnement des équipes Participer à la rédaction et à la revue de contrats commerciaux en français et en anglais (contrats SaaS, accords de confidentialité, contrats fournisseurs, accords de partenariat, etc.). Contribuer à l'analyse des clauses contractuelles, notamment celles relatives à la protection des données, à la confidentialité et à la responsabilité. Accompagner la Head of Legal dans le traitement des demandes juridiques des équipes opérationnelles. Participer à la mise à jour des modèles contractuels et des documents juridiques internes. 4. Veille juridique & projets transverses Assurer une veille juridique et réglementaire sur les évolutions en matière de protection des données personnelles, de droit du numérique et d'intelligence artificielle. Réaliser des recherches juridiques et rédiger des synthèses claires et accessibles pour les équipes internes. Contribuer à des projets transverses visant à améliorer les processus, les outils et la documentation juridique de Lengow. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances du RGPD et des principes fondamentaux de la protection des données personnelles. Vous portez un intérêt particulier aux évolutions réglementaires liées à l'intelligence artificielle, notamment à l'AI Act. Vous possédez de bonnes bases en droit des contrats. Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se, autonome et proactif.ve, avec de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous faites preuve de pédagogie pour rendre les sujets juridiques accessibles à des interlocuteurs non juristes et appréciez le travail en équipe. Notre processus de recrutement Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre Head of Legal pour faire connaissance et échanger sur votre parcours et vos motivations. Un entretien pour approfondir les échanges, vous présenter les missions et mieux comprendre vos attentes. Bienvenue chez Lengow ! Si nos attentes sont alignées, nous passons à la signature de votre convention de stage. raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. title: Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe. You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators. What You’ll Do Reporting & Insight Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers. Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance. Attribution & Incrementality Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal. Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google. Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results. Activation Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions. Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance → more spend” flywheel. Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients. Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact. What You Need 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products. Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV. Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals. A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers. Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance stack. Hands-on SQL and data exploration, and you’re comfortable in technical, data-intensive environments. The ability to bridge technical measurement and business/GTM stakeholders. Why This Role You’ll own the product domain that decides whether clients trust their Vibe spend, and whether they scale it. You’ll have a direct line to revenue, because measurement is Vibe’s main lever for retaining and growing clients. You’ll shape how an entire category proves CTV as a performance channel. You’ll have high autonomy and influence across functions, from data science to clients’ C-suite. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer The base pay range for this role in Paris is €99,000 – €133,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. The base pay range for this role in New York is $108,000 – $216,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up: Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers — Via Swile. Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role. Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit. Equal Opportunity Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe.

You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators.

What You’ll Do

Reporting & Insight

  • Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers.

  • Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance.

Attribution & Incrementality

  • Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal.

  • Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google.

  • Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results.

Activation

  • Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions.

  • Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance → more spend” flywheel.

  • Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients.

  • Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact.

What You Need

  • 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products.

  • Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV.

  • Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals.

  • A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers.

  • Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance stack.

  • Hands-on SQL and data exploration, and you’re comfortable in technical, data-intensive environments.

  • The ability to bridge technical measurement and business/GTM stakeholders.

Why This Role

  • You’ll own the product domain that decides whether clients trust their Vibe spend, and whether they scale it.

  • You’ll have a direct line to revenue, because measurement is Vibe’s main lever for retaining and growing clients.

  • You’ll shape how an entire category proves CTV as a performance channel.

  • You’ll have high autonomy and influence across functions, from data science to clients’ C-suite.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €99,000 – €133,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $108,000 – $216,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role.

  3. Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

  5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

description: <p><strong>REQ ID: FEQ227R147</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: France (Remote/Hybrid) - will require travel across Europe</strong></p> <p><strong>Recruiter: Dina Hussain</strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our <strong>EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups </strong>business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.</li> <li>Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.</li> <li>Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.</li> <li>Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. raw.title: HIL Engineer — Huracan Rocket Engine
raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

 

About the role

The Exploration Company is developing Huracan, a cryogenic rocket engine. The engine integrates e-pumps, power electronics, valves, embedded software, and control systems. We are seeking a Hardware-in-the-Loop Engineer to develop and operate HIL platforms for verifying the ECU, PDU, Valve Controller, inverter, electric pumps, and associated software. You will connect real hardware to real-time simulations, automate testing and data analysis, and develop emulator hardware for sensors, actuators, interfaces, and subsystem behaviour.

You will verify nominal and fault conditions while ensuring test repeatability, traceability, and early fault detection. You will work closely with propulsion, embedded-software, power-electronics, control-systems, and hardware engineers to validate Huracan from simulation through laboratory testing.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain the HIL test environment for our engine propulsion system, from engine controller board level up to the integrated propulsion subsystem

  • Define and implement the hardware and software architecture of the propulsion HIL bench, including signal conditioning, load and fault-insertion hardware, and real-time targets

  • Integrate real-time plant models (e.g., feed system, valves, pumps and motors, combustion chamber, thermal behaviour) into NI VeriStand and close the loop with the engine control unit

  • Emulate and simulate the sensors the controller depends on (e.g., pressure transducers, thermocouples and RTDs, flow meters, position and speed feedback) with flight-representative electrical characteristics

  • Emulate or integrate actuators and power electronics, such as valve drivers, motor inverters, igniters, and their control units, as real hardware, electrical loads, or models

  • Develop LabVIEW-based applications for desktop and real-time platforms (e.g., PXI, cRIO), including custom devices and bus interfaces (e.g., CAN, RS-422/485, Ethernet)

  • Implement fault injection at the electrical and model level to verify engine start-up, shutdown, and abort sequences as well as FDIR behaviour

  • Support test execution, data acquisition, logging, and automated reporting during verification campaigns

  • Validate and correlate simulation models against component-level and engine test data together with the propulsion team

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture specifications, interface definitions, model and code documentation, and user guides

  • Debug and troubleshoot across the bench, the models, and the unit under test, and continuously improve the test platform

You will be in charge of

  • Delivering a robust and scalable HIL platform whose models, I/O configuration, and test sequences can be reused across engine configurations and projects

  • Running control loops and plant models deterministically at the rates the engine controller requires, using NI hardware, LabVIEW RT, and FPGA where timing demands it

  • Defining test automation workflows using NI TestStand and integrating them into the propulsion and system-level verification process

  • Coordinating closely with propulsion, avionics, and flight software engineers to ensure requirements traceability and test coverage

  • Keeping models, bench hardware, and test software under configuration control so that every test run is reproducible

  • Contributing to the continuous evolution of our HiL infrastructure, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Ensuring all solutions meet space-grade quality and safety standards, aligned with project requirements

Must-Have Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience building and operating HIL test benches for closed-loop control systems (e.g., engine, motor, or actuator controllers)

  • Proficiency in LabVIEW, including desktop and real-time application development

  • Hands-on experience with NI VeriStand in real-time test environments, including integration of simulation models (e.g., Simulink, FMU, or C/C++)

  • Experience emulating sensors and actuators at the electrical level (e.g., analog, thermocouple/RTD, frequency and PWM, discrete I/O) and working with motor drives or inverters

  • Familiarity with NI TestStand for test automation and execution management

  • Solid understanding of test platform architectures, hardware/software integration, and real-time systems

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with a structured and methodical approach

  • Ability to write and integrate Python scripts to extend test workflows or support automation tasks

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with LabVIEW FPGA, for example for high-speed sensor emulation or motor and inverter simulation

  • Background in liquid rocket propulsion or in fluid and thermal system modelling

  • Experience with fault-insertion hardware and FDIR verification

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards or equivalent aerospace standards such as DO-178C

  • Experience supporting engine or integrated system test campaigns

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

As a Research Engineer on the Orchestral team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. Orchestral is the system our researchers rely on to run training and evaluation at scale — from the rollout engine that powers agentic workflows to the infrastructure that keeps their workloads running reliably. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on.

Your work will span the platform's core: the library, tooling, abstractions and rollout engine — including new capabilities like long-running tasks, subagents and RL features — and the machinery that runs data and jobs at scale, with a focus on resiliency, routing and request handling. You will own significant pieces end to end, from design to production.

This is a software engineering role rather than an ML or infrastructure-operations one: RL or PyTorch experience is not required, and you will spend your time building the platform, not operating it. You will be building a distributed RL system, with the scientists as your users.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models.

  • Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long-running tasks and subagents.

  • Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale.

  • Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling.

  • Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation.

  • Contribute to open-source rollout-engine and agent-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience directly building and debugging complex distributed systems at scale, with an emphasis on reliability and scalability.

  • Strong Python skills and solid software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • A builder mindset: you have constructed systems from the ground up, not just operated polished ones.

  • A track record in small teams running complex systems at scale — for example in finance, crypto or ad tech.

  • Self-starter, low-ego and collaborative, with a product mindset toward your users.

  • Curiosity about ML and RL — this experience is not required, but a desire to learn is.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on experience with Ray or similar distributed-computing frameworks.

  • Open-source contributions, especially to rollout-engine or agent-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL.

  • Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About the role

Mirakl is looking for a senior contractor to join its Finance team and provide operational leadership in an international, multi-entity environment.

Reporting to the Accounting & Tax Director, you will secure the continuity and quality of day-to-day accounting operations while supporting the monthly and annual close.

The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the Finance function, particularly through the identification, testing and adoption of relevant automation and AI use cases. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to process improvement and change management.

Contractor

6 months

Start: ASAP 

Location: Paris or Bordeaux (aller-retour à prévoir à Bordeaux 1 fois par mois)

Key responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay

  • Own and coordinate the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier creation and invoice receipt through to validation, booking and payment.
  • Coordinate the Accounts Payable team and ensure timely processing of invoices across Mirakl's entities.
  • Monitor invoice workflows, approvals, purchase orders, blocked invoices and outstanding supplier balances.
  • Review invoice coding, supporting documentation and accounting treatment, and act as an escalation point for complex supplier issues.
  • Coordinate payment runs and ensure that payment files are prepared accurately and in line with internal approval procedures.
  • Maintain robust controls over vendor master data, bank details, payment approvals and segregation of duties.

Accounting operations and close support

  • Support the Accounting & Tax Director in the coordination of the monthly and annual close process.
  • Review AP-related cut-off and other accounting entries.
  • Monitor the reconciliation and clean-up of relevant balance sheet accounts and support the review of intercompany transactions.
  • Coordinate with local accounting firms and external service providers across Mirakl's international perimeter.
  • Contribute to audit preparation and respond to requests from external auditors and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure that accounting evidence, procedures and control documentation are complete, accessible and up to date.

Finance transformation, automation and AI

  • Contribute to Mirakl's Finance AI transformation roadmap by identifying high-value use cases within AP, Procure-to-Pay and accounting operations.
  • Participate in discovery phases, workshops and experiments aimed at improving invoice processing, data quality, reconciliations, reporting and operational support.
  • Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders.
  • Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives.
  • Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working.
  • Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes.

Candidate profile

  • 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management
  • Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director
  • Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls.
  • Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries.
  • Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems
  • Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases.
  • Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills.
  • Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

  • Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders.
  • Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives.
  • Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working.
  • Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes.

Candidate profile

  • 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management
  • Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director
  • Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls.
  • Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries.
  • Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems
  • Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases.
  • Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills.
  • Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage.
